title: Hero stats modal with dynamic details list (Home page)

requirements.summary: Make Hero stats (10+ Years Experience, 1000+ Happy Clients) open a reliable dynamic modal/dialog on the Home page with a scrollable 1–1000 list and proper close behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: On the Home page Hero section, clicking the "Years Experience" stat opens a modal/dialog.
Clicking the "Happy Clients" stat opens a modal/dialog.
The modal/dialog content is dynamically generated (not a static screenshot/image) and renders a scrollable list of numbers from 1 to 1000 inclusive.
The modal/dialog can be closed via an explicit close control and by dismissing the dialog (per existing dialog behavior).
No console errors occur when opening/closing the modal/dialog in a production build.

file_operations.description: Harden the Hero stats click-to-open behavior by keeping dialog state deterministic for production builds (e.g., type="button" on stat triggers, reset modal title on close, and avoid unnecessary re-creation of the 1–1000 list via memoization). Use the shadcn-ui Dialog and ScrollArea components to provide the modal/dismiss behavior and scrollable content; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
